text_block_list.text:
"...I can hear it. I can truly feel it. 
Riding on the blowing wind, the cheers and 
feelings strike upon my very being—"
choice_data_list:
(Could Stego also be feeling this right 
now—)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Toward the scenery that lies ahead――――!!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let me stay by your side until the very 
end, Suzuka!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!! Seizing the glory of the 
Emperor's Shield is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I've crossed it... That 
massive fork in the road...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooooh!! What an amazing race! Stay 
Gold, Silence Suzuka, all of them... 
they're just too incredible...!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I'm almost crying...!! I wanna 
see another race like that...!

I'm proud of Stay Gold for putting up such 
an incredible race. On the other hand...

The moment Stay Gold crossed the finish 
line, I definitely heard it. I felt it.

That something decisive, something of no 
return, had crumbled away without a trace—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Even though I couldn't reach that 
scenery—

text_block_list.name: Suzuka's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were so, so cool--! I'll be cheering 
for you next time too--!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race today. Your running 
was incredible.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Let's run again. And next time, let's 
make it an even more exciting race.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "That's all I wanted to say. ――――See ya."

And so, Stay Gold's decisive Classic-class 
battle, the Tenno Sho (Autumn), came to an 
end—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...It might be a good idea to pause for a 
moment right about here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We just ran through a massive storm. We 
need some time to open up the map again, 
right?

We haven't decided on our next target race 
yet. However—

Just as Stay Gold said, let's pause and 
take a breather for now. Then, we should 
review things once more.

Where we stand right now. And where the 
ultimate goal we must strive for lies.
